title: Path of Exile 2 0.4.0 Druid & Shapeshift System: Talisman, Primal Skills and Why Old Builds Break
summary: How Druid, Oracle and Shaman entered the game in 0.4.0, why Talisman is a transform weapon, and why pre-0.4.0 Druid builds fail skill-ID, weapon and passive checks.
description: A system-level history of the 0.4.0 Druid and Shapeshift framework: Animal Forms, Primal Skills, Lineage Supports, Talisman weapon rules, the 0.4.0i crit-condition fix, and a migration guide for old Druid layouts.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 Druid in fire bear shapeshift form

sections.title: Historical context
sections.era: Path of Exile 2 Early Access — 0.4.0 Druid framework
sections.baselineNote: Current rules below are measured against client 0.5.4e.

cards.detail: Selectable class in 0.5.4e; Shapeshift identity intact.
Ward/prophecy-leaning Druid ascendancy; node cluster unchanged in identity.
Druid-specific clusters exist; old 'no Druid nodes' guides are wrong.

sections.title: Weapon & skill relationship
sections.oldText: A 'Druid' would just use a staff or sceptre like any caster and socket generic supports.
sections.newText: Shapeshift requires a Talisman weapon; Primal Skills are inert without an active or recent form; Lineage Supports only fit Primal Skills.

changes.title: 250+ Druid passive skills
changes.detail: New clusters for Shapeshift duration, Primal Skill effect, and form crit. Pre-0.4.0 passive planners had no such nodes.

changes.title: Form-gating on passives
changes.detail: Some Druid passives only grant bonuses while transformed, a state the old tree could not represent.

changes.title: 0.4.0i 'recently Shapeshifted' crit
changes.detail: Crit condition now reliably procs after leaving a form, fixing Bear/Spriggan crit builds.

changes.title: 0.4.0i Talisman requirement checks
changes.detail: Client now correctly validates Talisman weapon requirements before enabling transform affixes.

changes.title: Console crash fixes
changes.detail: 0.4.0i resolved several client crashes on Xbox/PS5 during form swaps.

steps.from: Old 'Druid' layout using a staff + generic supports
steps.to: Talisman weapon + Primal Skills + Lineage Supports
steps.note: Swap the weapon base first; Primal Skills are inert without Talisman.

steps.to: Lineage Supports for Primal Skills only
steps.note: Lineage Supports do not socket into non-Primal skills; keep generic supports for non-Primal links.

steps.to: Add 0.4.0 Druid clusters (form duration, Primal effect)
steps.note: Pre-0.4.0 planners lacked these nodes entirely.

steps.from: Crit stacking that ignored form state
steps.note: After 0.4.0i the condition procs reliably post-form.

rows.currentSummary: Shapeshift still requires a Talisman; the 0.4.0i requirement-check fix is in effect.
Lineage Supports still only socket into Primal Skills.
0.4.0i fixed it; later balance may have adjusted crit numbers but the condition works.

reports.context: Bear builds reported crits not proccing after leaving form.
reports.quote: My crit condition never triggers after I un-bear.
reports.analysis: Fixed in 0.4.0i. On 0.5.4e the condition works, so legacy complaints no longer apply.

reports.context: Videos titled 'Druid build' from before 0.4.0 describe a class that did not exist.
reports.quote: This whole guide is for a class that isn't in the game yet.
reports.analysis: Correct at the time; obsolete now. Use post-0.4.0 Druid content only.

rows.name: Bear Shaman Druid build
rows.action: Verify Talisman rules and 0.4.0i crit fix.
